name: WPIL Ltd
title: WPIL Ltd - 505872 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Consolidated Q4 revenue fell 11% to INR511 crore while standalone project revenue collapsed to INR92 crore from INR253 crore; FY26 order book ~INR6,000 crore largely from a South African win, with JJM receivables stuck (~INR350 crore overdue).

capex.quote: We don't see much capex demand requirement, but we do see some small brownfield addition needed to take care of the excess -- the capacity required for Indian growth, product growth.

triggers.label: JJM receivables ~INR350 crore overdue
triggers.quote: the total clear receivables overdue to us is roughly about INR350 crores

triggers.label: South Africa order win ~ZAR4 billion
triggers.quote: Including South Africa, our order book is right now about ZAR4 billion.

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 revenue guidance
triggers.quote: we would not like to do that, but we will be updating

triggers.label: Consol EBITDA margin 17.16% FY26
triggers.quote: EBITDA rising 9% and margins improving to 17.16%

guidance.quote: our main mandate has always been to add the EBITDA margins between 15% to 20% on a whole

red_flags.label: JJM receivables stuck, no movement
red_flags.quote: it's a major area which is stuck with dead --no movement on this for some time

red_flags.label: Q4 consol revenue down 11%, standalone project revenue down sharply
red_flags.quote: the project business continued to remain subdued during the quarter with revenues at INR92 crores compared to INR253 crores last year

red_flags.label: NSE listing not yet applied; capital raise needed
red_flags.quote: we are unable to comply until we raise funds

evasions.quote: No, we would not like to do that, but we will be updating
I think we will see on the higher side, as we have said, the bandwidth we look at is 15% to 20%.
you cannot take 1 quarter and one area because as a benchmark and extrapolate
